examples.title: Airfoil
examples.note: A NACA 0012 airfoil (48 points, cosine spacing) in a channel, with no size limit: the triangles grade themselves outwards from the airfoil.

examples.title: Slot
examples.note: A narrow slot with a slanted end. It is the one example where every construction stage has work to do.

examples.title: Sharp corner
examples.note: A polygon with a 10° corner, sharper than the 30° target, and a size limit of 0.3.

examples.title: Square with hole
examples.note: A 4 × 4 square with a 1 × 1 hole and a size limit of 0.5.

examples.title: Slanted hole
examples.note: A slanted four-sided plate with a slanted four-sided hole and a size limit of 0.3: no side is parallel to an axis.
